title: Canonical constant-extension sheet pullbacks and return comparison
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$, an integer $m\ge1$, and a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $X_0$. Use its constant-extension datum $D_m$, $k_m$-model $X_{0,m}$, original-base model $X_{0,m}\to\operatorname{Spec}k_0$, geometric fibres $X_m=X_{0,m}\times_{k_m}k$ and $Y=X_{0,m}\times_{k_0}k$, and distinguished sheet $j:X_m\to Y$ of [def-dl-a1-constant-extension-data]. Write $H:Y\to Y$ for geometric $q$-Frobenius and $g_m:X_m\to X_m$ for geometric $q^m$-Frobenius [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]; here $H^n$ ($n\ge1$) is the positive iterate of $H$ of [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace], indexed there by $n-1$. Their canonical sheet-return identity is $j\circ g_m=H^m\circ j$ (ordinary functional composition). Fix a prime $\ell\ne p$ and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$. All categories are the actual common-stage categories $D^b_c(-,\Omega)$ of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], all Frobenius pullbacks are those used in the fixed-pair Weil categories of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], and every pullback is the common-stage derived pullback of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Define the distinguished-sheet pullback $J_0=Lj^*:D^b_c(Y,\Omega)\to D^b_c(X_m,\Omega)$ and, for each $0\le i<m$, the semilinear-coordinate pullback $J_i=L(H^i\circ j)^*$ between the same categories, on objects and morphisms. Define the natural return comparison at $M\in D^b_c(Y,\Omega)$ by
$$\rho_M:L g_m^*(Lj^*M)\xrightarrow{\sim}Lj^*(L(H^m)^*M).$$
It is the composite of the inverse of the integral-normalized pullback compositor for $g_m,j$, the equality comparison supplied by $j\circ g_m=H^m\circ j$, and the integral-normalized pullback compositor for $j,H^m$, all as specified in [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category]. These constructions are respectively constantExtensionSheetPull, constantExtensionSheetPullAt and constantExtensionReturnComparison; no $k$-linearity of $H^i\circ j$ is asserted.
